feeds.title: Salt Lake City Weekly » Arts and Entertainment
feeds.description: Salt Lake City Weekly has been Utah's source of independent news and in-depth journalism since 1984. Its mission is to provide thorough, relevant and interesting reporting and writing on local news, arts, and entertainment for the progressive, active, thoughtful residents of Salt Lake City and the environs. And in the process, set the standard for journalistic quality for this community.

feeds.title: Utah Theatre Bloggers
feeds.description: The Utah Theater Blogger Association is comprised of a group of theatre patrons and professionals dedicated to the creation and support of theatre by providing honest, quality reviews of productions across the state. Check out their recent articles and reviews on various theatre performances and also read interviews with the people behind the scenes and on stage.

feeds.title: The Utah Review
feeds.description: The Utah Review is Utah's premier independent arts magazine, focused on covering the very best of the local arts scene. The writers cover everything from film to theatre to dance; always with a critical focus on Utah first and foremost.

feeds.title: Visit Salt Lake Blog » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: Visit Salt Lake is a private, nonprofit corporation responsible for the promotion of Salt Lake as a convention and travel destination. It improves the area's economy by attracting and providing support to conventions, leisure travellers and visitors. The organization has a strong commitment to sustainability and stewardship of the area's natural environment. Its blog has a dedicated arts and culture section that gives insight into the city's life.

feeds.title: Utah Arts Review
feeds.description: Utah Arts Review was launched on September 1, 2018, by Lawrence A. Johnson. He is the former classical music critic of the Miami Herald, and, before that, a classical music writer at the South Florida Sun-Sentinel. He was a freelance critic for the Chicago Tribune throughout the 1990s, covering classical music as well as rock and theatre, and wrote regularly for the New York Times, the Boston Globe, Opera News, Opera and The New Criterion.

feeds.title: Utah Arts Alliance Blog
feeds.description: Utah Arts Alliance provides unique services and programs that benefit our communities by providing the infrastructure that enables people to pursue their creative dreams and experience art in their community. It fosters the arts in all forms to create an aware, empowered, and connected community. Its goal is to benefit its community by providing the infrastructure that enables people from all walks of life, especially those who lack financial resources, to pursue their creative dreams and experience art in their community.

feeds.title: Utah Division of Arts & Museums Blog
feeds.description: Utah Arts & Museums seeks to advance Utahns' quality of life through arts and museum experiences and cultural opportunities. It is a service organization offering a variety of professional development opportunities and grants to serve its constituents. Its goal is to promote the value and impact of its cultural community.

feeds.title: Utah's Art Magazine
feeds.description: Artists of Utah was founded on September 1, 2001, and is a non-profit organization headquartered in Salt Lake City. The organization was created to serve as a communication nexus for Utah's visual arts community. It is made up of artists, art lovers, and art professionals and exists to bring the same together on one platform.

feeds.title: Park City Magazine
feeds.description: Park City Magazine is your guide to arts, culture, and events in Park City, Utah. It explores the region's abundant outdoor recreation opportunities, vibrant visual and performing arts, colourful local characters, and rich local history, making it a must-read for both residents and visitors alike.

feeds.title: Utah Film Center
feeds.description: Utah Film Center is a nonprofit organization that utilizes the power of film to educate, inspire, and engage Utahns, transcending political, geographic, cultural, and religious boundaries to highlight human experiences from around the world. It provides a curated platform for independent voices year-round. It envisions a world where all of Utah's communities feel welcome, valued, and creatively empowered to make the world a better place.

feeds.title: Tuacahn Center for the Arts
feeds.description: Tuacahn Center for the Arts edifies and inspires the human spirit through professional world-class family entertainment and an unparalleled artistic and educational experience that matches the majesty of our canyon. It produces quality entertainment of the highest professional standards that promote family values, uplift the human spirit and enrich the human mind.

feeds.title: Ogden Contemporary Arts News
feeds.description: OGDEN CONTEMPORARY ARTS inspires local and regional artists through active involvement with the international contemporary art community. It strives to be viewed as a credible and internationally respected art establishment; while empowering artists with the facilities, environment and experience to excel in their medium and enrich their lives.

feeds.title: Susan Swartz Blog
feeds.description: Susan Swartz's work as an artist, activist, and documentary film producer has focused on changing the way people see the world around them. By shedding light on important issues such as the fragility of the natural world and social injustice, she hopes to shift thinking, inspire change and provide a message of hope. Keep up-to-date on the latest from Susan Swartz Studios and the goings-on of the eponymous artist.

feeds.title: Arts Council Park City & Summit County Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1986, the Arts Council Park City & Summit County is one of the oldest arts and culture organizations in Park City. It is an umbrella nonprofit organization that conducts marketing, creative programming, public art activities, and policy/advocacy work. It envisions a community where Arts and culture are critical, where creatives thrive, and where all people connect through the arts. Read stories about local arts and culture events and profiles about local creatives in Park City and Summit County, UT.

feeds.title: Alex Tebow Blog
feeds.description: Alex is an artist and mom. She loves the outdoors, travel, soccer, and getting completely lost in a great book. She is highly experienced with vector illustration; whether it's creating graphics from scratch, or manipulating existing graphics and text. She can create business branding, product manuals, annual reports, social media graphics, apparel mockups and graphics, and activity sheets & workbooks for children, and colouring pages.

feeds.title: UVU REVIEW » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: UVU REVIEW is an independent platform where students voice their opinions. It's all about excellence, accuracy, and integrity. They write about everything that goes on in UVU, be it arts, culture, sports, health, wellness, news, or anything else.

feeds.title: The Daily Utah Chronicle » Arts
feeds.description: Founded in 1890, The Daily Utah Chronicle is an independent student publication published in print and online. It publishes news, and articles about arts, sports, opinions, editorials, and investigations.

feeds.title: TownLift » Arts & Entertainment
feeds.description: TownLift is Park City's and Summit County's source for community news. Launched in December 2020, they publish news and stories affecting everyday life in Park City for residents and visitors alike. With an all-local focus, they serve as a catalyst to strengthen community values and support local organizations. Readers will find news, art, entertainment, events, real estate, dining, and more.

feeds.title: Utah Museum of Contemporary Art News
feeds.description: The Utah Museum of Contemporary Art believes in the power of the art of their time. Through programming, advocacy, and collaboration, they work with artists and communities to build a better world. Since 1931, it has been a gathering space for artists and creatives in its region.

feeds.title: SLUG Magazine » Arts
feeds.description: SLUG Magazine's mission is to amplify Salt Lake City's thriving alternative and underrepresented music, arts, events and community subcultures with thoughtful media coverage and exclusive event curation. Since 1989, it has given a voice to Utah's community and continues to expand its coverage in both print and digital media.

feeds.title: Anthony's Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Anthony's Fine Art & Antiques is a family-run art and antique gallery that was established almost three decades ago. Their focus has expanded to include discovering, preserving, and promoting furniture, decorative arts, jewellery, paintings, and sculpture.

feeds.title: Altus Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Altus Fine Art is an LDS art publisher focusing on Christ and home-centred artwork. They work with talented and devoted artists and turn their artwork into affordable products that range from small prints to large framed canvas masterpieces, and everything in between. Fine art prints, giclee canvases, gifts & more.

feeds.title: Stephanie Hock Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Stephanie Hock is fascinated with how art tells the story of people. It continues to be a favourite theme in her work - watching individuals or groups of people unposed, living their lives. She finds beauty and meaning in what their ordinary gestures tell about their feelings, relationships, values, humour and their society as a whole. She loves to paint the joy of the human experience. Follow along to see what she's working on next!

feeds.title: Dana Worley, Fused Glass Designs
feeds.description: Dana Worley is a fused glass designer. Her home studio lies in the foothills of Northern Utah. This beautiful high mountain desert, its surrounding areas, and her travel experiences inspire her art. This blog includes many tutorials, which she hopes you'll find useful. Her interests are mountain biking, hiking, gardening, photography, travel, and cross-country skiing.

feeds.title: Roland Lee Blog
feeds.description: Roland Lee has become nationally known for his transparent watercolours of the southwest landscape, the pioneer west, and rural European scenes. Since 1979 he has concentrated on the medium of transparent watercolour using no white, black, or opaque paints. His paintings have been featured in 'American Watercolor Weekly', 'Plein Air Magazine,' 'Western Art Collector Magazine', 'Southwest Art', 'The Artist's Magazine,' 'Western Art and Architecture Magazine', and 'Art West' magazine.

feeds.title: Sundance Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Sundance Institute is a nonprofit organization dedicated to the discovery and development of independent artists and audiences. Through its programs, the Institute seeks to discover, support, and inspire independent film and media artists from the United States and around the world, and to introduce audiences to their new work. Read about movies, reviews, announcements, awards, nominations, feature stories and many more interesting articles about the movie industry in the Sundance Blog.

feeds.title: Salt Lake County Arts & Culture Blog
feeds.description: Salt Lake County agency is dedicated to building deep and engaging connections and dialogue around the arts and culture in their community. For more than forty years, they have been an active participant in the arts community, providing the spaces, places and services to create and perform great art. Their mission is to advocate for the support of arts organizations and facilities within Salt Lake County.

feeds.title: Kimball Art Center
feeds.description: The Kimball Art Center provides international quality art exhibitions and dynamic educational opportunities for the citizens of Park City, Summit County, Wasatch County, and the region's many visitors. It inspires, educates, and connects through art by offering exhibitions, classes, and events to Park City residents and visitors. Since 1976, it has been a resource for creative expression, social connection, and community dialogue.

feeds.title: Salt Lake Film Society Blog
feeds.description: Salt Lake Film Society is a proud non-profit organization with an active board, a creative and hard-working staff, and a shared passion for cinema. They educate, advocate, and inform about - and through - cinema. They promote diversity through film exhibitions and creations. They foster film talent and cultivate film appreciation and participation. They bring artists, their films, and audiences together to experience the film the way it was meant to be seen, in a darkened room, on a big screen, in the company of friends, family, and neighbours.

feeds.title: Utah Arts For Life
feeds.description: The Utah Partnership for Arts Education (UPAE) is a partnership between professional arts education organizations in Utah. They share the stories of the student artists in Utah schools by empowering teachers to support student well-being through the arts with strategies, tools, and resources.

feeds.title: Cody Rex Chamberlain
feeds.description: Cody Rex Chamberlain was born and raised in Utah and spent his childhood roaming the high west desert of Utah. His work with the Forest Service has afforded him a unique opportunity to attain professional training as a naturalist and create service and educational programs that teach the public about environmental responsibility. His art is a visual representation of an experience, a meld of past and present experiences.

feeds.title: Inspiration Haven Art Studio Blog
feeds.description: Inspiration Haven Art Studio offers kid's art classes, paint nights, corporate events, birthday parties, private paint parties, and more! Their blog offers informative articles, ideas, thoughts, and more! Learn about various artists, techniques and paint tools. They try to cover all things art!

feeds.title: Salt Lake Magazine » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: Readers trust Salt Lake magazine to be on the front lines of local fashion, trends and dining. Discover Salt Lake magazine's Arts and Entertainment section with reviews of visual arts, music, theatre and events in and across Utah.
